dog.description_text:
Bentley is a sweet, friendly guy who loves being around people and getting lots of pets. As he gets comfortable with you, he’ll even lean his head against you for a little extra affection. His foster jokes that Bentley should carry a sign that says, “Pet me, I’m friendly,” because he stops in front of just about everyone he meets hoping for some attention!

Bentley can be energetic and playful but also knows when it’s time to relax! He’ll make a great, adorable, loving companion.

If this dog is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
